name: tide-tables
description: Printable monthly tide calendars from NOAA tide predictions.

interface.longDescription:
Make a printable monthly tide calendar for a US NOAA tide station: predicted high and low tide times and heights, sunrise and sunset for each day, a tide chart, and PDF, CSV and ICS calendar files.

Name a coastal town or a station, and the plugin finds the nearest NOAA tide prediction stations with their distance. Pick a month or any period up to 31 days, in feet or meters above Mean Lower Low Water (MLLW), in the station's local time. The calendar marks days when the clocks change.

Planning a low-tide outing? Add a filter such as low tides at or below 0 ft, between 6 and 10 AM, or in daylight only, and the matching tides are listed and highlighted in the calendar, the PDF and a separate ICS file you can add to your calendar app.

The data is NOAA CO-OPS tide predictions (tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov), fetched from NOAA and cached for up to 24 hours. Tide calendar results and files show the station, datum, time zone, source and retrieval time. These are predictions, not observations: wind, air pressure and river flow change the actual water level. Sunrise and sunset are computed from the station position. Covers NOAA CO-OPS prediction stations on US coasts, territories and some Pacific islands. Place search covers US places of about 15,000 people or more and NOAA station names.
defaultPrompt: Tide calendar for San Francisco station 9414290 for December 2026 as a printable PDF
Low tides at or below 0 ft in daylight near Monterey, CA in January 2027
Printable tide table for Montauk, NY for July 2027 in meters with a calendar file

positive.description: Month calendar with a low-tide filter
positive.prompt: Make a tide calendar for NOAA station 9414290 (San Francisco) for November 2026 and highlight low tides at or below 0.5 ft in daylight.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the November 2026 calendar for station 9414290 with 58 highs and 58 lows, lowest low -1.7 ft on 2026-11-25, 6 matching daylight low tides, sun times, and PDF, CSV and ICS links.

positive.prompt: Which NOAA tide stations are closest to Monterey, CA?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 5 nearest NOAA tide stations to Monterey, CA with distance in miles, starting with station 9413450 MONTEREY, MONTEREY BAY.

positive.prompt: Tide table for The Battery, New York, station 8518750, for March 2026, marking low tides between 6 and 10 AM.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 60 highs and 60 lows for March 2026 in EST and EDT, marks the clock change on 2026-03-08, lowest low -0.8 ft on 2026-03-03, and 8 matching low tides.

positive.prompt: Find NOAA tide stations named Montauk in New York.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the NOAA tide stations whose names contain Montauk in NY, including 8510560 Montauk, Fort Pond Bay and 8510502 Montauk Harbor entrance.

positive.prompt: Honolulu tide calendar for January 2027 from station 1612340, with low tides at or below 0 ft highlighted.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the January 2027 calendar for station 1612340 in HST with 33 low tides at or below 0 ft, lowest low -0.4 ft on 2027-01-20, and PDF, CSV and ICS links.

negative.prompt: What is the surf forecast for Malibu this weekend?
negative.description: Do not call a tool; surf and wave forecasts are outside tide predictions.

negative.prompt: Will it rain in Seattle tomorrow?
negative.description: Do not call a tool; weather forecasts are outside tide predictions.

negative.prompt: What water level is the Battery gauge reading right now?
negative.description: Do not call a tool; observed real-time water levels are outside these tide predictions.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: NOAA tide station search, monthly tide calendars with sunrise and sunset, low-tide filters, PDF (Letter and A4), CSV and ICS files.

pl-PL.subtitle: Miesięczne kalendarze pływów
pl-PL.description: Drukowany miesięczny kalendarz pływów dla stacji NOAA w USA: godziny i wysokości przypływów i odpływów, wschód i zachód słońca, wykres oraz pliki PDF, CSV i ICS. To prognozy, nie pomiary.

de-DE.subtitle: Monatliche Gezeitenkalender
de-DE.description: Druckbarer Gezeitenkalender für eine NOAA-Station in den USA: Zeiten und Höhen von Hoch- und Niedrigwasser, Sonnenauf- und -untergang, Diagramm sowie PDF-, CSV- und ICS-Dateien. Vorhersagen, keine Messwerte.

es-ES.subtitle: Calendarios de mareas

fr-FR.subtitle: Calendriers des marées
fr-FR.description: Calendrier mensuel des marées à imprimer pour une station NOAA aux États-Unis : heures et hauteurs des pleines et basses mers, lever et coucher du soleil, graphique et fichiers PDF, CSV et ICS. Ce sont des prédictions, pas des observations.

ja-JP.subtitle: 月間の潮汐カレンダー
ja-JP.description: 米国NOAA観測所の月間潮汐カレンダーを印刷用に作成します。満潮・干潮の時刻と潮位、日の出・日の入り、グラフ、PDF・CSV・ICSファイル付き。観測値ではなく予測値です。

pt-BR.subtitle: Calendários de marés
pt-BR.description: Calendário mensal de marés para imprimir de uma estação NOAA dos EUA: horários e alturas de preamar e baixa-mar, nascer e pôr do sol, gráfico e arquivos PDF, CSV e ICS. São previsões, não observações.
